kotlinProjectFiles.description: Declares RECORD_AUDIO and scoped local storage permissions with zero internet permissions for strict air-gapped operation.
kotlinProjectFiles.code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    package="com.voxalocal.offlinespeech">

    <!-- 100% Offline Operation: Explicitly NO android.permission.INTERNET -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO" />
    <!-- Scoped storage support for Android 9 and below; Android 10+ uses app-specific filesDir -->
    <uses-permission
        android:name="android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"
        android:maxSdkVersion="28" />
    <uses-permission
        android:name="android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"
        android:maxSdkVersion="32" />

    <application
        android:allowBackup="true"
        android:label="VoxaLocal Offline Speech"
        android:supportsRtl="true"
        android:theme="@android:style/Theme.Material.Light.NoActionBar">
        <activity
            android:name=".MainActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:configChanges="orientation|screenSize|screenLayout|keyboardHidden">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>
    </application>
</manifest>

kotlinProjectFiles.description: Local Vosk Kaldi / Whisper-lite acoustic frame processor with custom regional phonetic substitution rules and lexicon graph boosting.
Captures 16kHz 16-bit PCM mono audio via Android AudioRecord, computes 24-band live amplitudes for Jetpack Compose Canvas, and writes RIFF WAV headers.
kotlinProjectFiles.code:
package com.voxalocal.offlinespeech.audio

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.media.AudioFormat
import android.media.AudioRecord
import android.media.MediaRecorder
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.RandomAccessFile
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder

class AudioRecorderManager(private val sampleRate: Int = 16000) {
    private var audioRecord: AudioRecord? = null
    private var recordingJob: Job? = null

    private val _isRecording = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isRecording: StateFlow<Boolean> = _isRecording

    private val _waveformBands = MutableStateFlow(List(24) { 0.08f })
    val waveformBands: StateFlow<List<Float>> = _waveformBands

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    fun startRecording(
        outputWavFile: File,
        scope: CoroutineScope,
        onAudioFrame: (ShortArray, Int) -> Float
    ) {
        val minBuf = AudioRecord.getMinBufferSize(
            sampleRate,
            AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO,
            AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT
        ).coerceAtLeast(sampleRate / 5)

        audioRecord = AudioRecord(
            MediaRecorder.AudioSource.VOICE_RECOGNITION,
            sampleRate,
            AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO,
            AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT,
            minBuf
        )
        audioRecord?.startRecording()
        _isRecording.value = true

        recordingJob = scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val pcmBuffer = ShortArray(1024)
            var totalBytes = 0L
            FileOutputStream(outputWavFile).use { fos ->
                fos.write(ByteArray(44))
                while (isActive && _isRecording.value) {
                    val read = audioRecord?.read(pcmBuffer, 0, pcmBuffer.size) ?: 0
                    if (read > 0) {
                        onAudioFrame(pcmBuffer, read)
                        val byteBuf = ByteBuffer.allocate(read * 2).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                        for (i in 0 until read) byteBuf.putShort(pcmBuffer[i])
                        fos.write(byteBuf.array())
                        totalBytes += read * 2
                    }
                }
            }
            writeWavHeader(outputWavFile, totalBytes, sampleRate, 1, 16)
        }
    }
}
